articles.title: Retiring Smithsonian head Lonnie G. Bunch III: "You can run from history, but you can't hide" - CBS News
articles.description: In 2019, Bunch became both the first historian and the first African American to serve as Secretary of the Smithsonian Institution. As he prepares to retire, he talks about the museums' mission to protect history, and give America a full picture of itself.
articles.content:
When Lonnie G. Bunch III walks through the Smithsonian's National Air and Space Museum in Washington, D.C., his love of history is on full display. "I just love this museum so much," he said.
